body:
Maria (Support): Finly (tenant=finly-prod) complaining of intermittent 5xx + extreme tail p99s since ~17:12 UTC. Multiple customer calls. They see 504s and timeouts, and some requests hang for >30s. Logged x-req-id: abc123-def456.
Alex (SRE): Investigating graphs now. Any repro payloads?
Maria (Support): Customer sent a longseq example (seq_len=4096) and a batch of parallel requests. Provided a curl: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate`
oncall-bot: Alert: hosted-gateway p95_latency > 1200ms for tenant finly-prod between 17:10-17:20 UTC. queue_depth=~6200.
Priya (Eng Runtime): Looking at continuous-batcher backlog for finly-prod. current snapshot: `queue_depth=6123`, `dequeue_rate=130 req/s`, `avg_batch_size=18`, `kv_cache_misses=high`. Pattern: steady enqueue with long sequences causing KV-cache spin and poor eviction -> backlog grows.
Alex (SRE): Can you paste the batcher logs for last 5m? especially evict/kv messages.
Priya (Eng Runtime): Pasting trimmed logs: ```
[17:14:03] batcher: enqueue tenant=finly-prod req=abc123 seq=4096
[17:14:03] batcher: worker 7 spin-up kv_cache miss slot=72
[17:14:05] batcher: batch formed size=19 latency_wait=240ms
[17:14:10] runtime: model forward took 950ms (quant path)
[17:14:13] batcher: kv_cache evict count=42 pressure=0.87
[17:15:02] batcher: queue_depth=5890
[17:16:55] batcher: queue_depth=6123 backlog_growth=+233
```
Maria (Support): Customer saw repeated `504` with these `x-req-id`s: abc123-def456, ghi789-jkl012.
Alex (SRE): Hypothesis: long sequences from this tenant plus high kv cache churn are producing head-of-line blocking and continuous-batcher starvation -> tail latency. Also enqueue rate briefly exceeded our configured `queue_depth_limit` and adaptive shedding didn't trigger fast enough.
Priya (Eng Runtime): Agreed. Quick mitigations I can try: 1) Reduce per-tenant queue_depth to 4k for hosted (temp) 2) Lower max_batch_wait to 20ms for that tenant 3) Flip `prefer-small-batches` routing for finly-prod to avoid big longseq bundling.
Sam (Customer Success): Customer is on a call, can we give ETA for fix? They ask for 10-15min mitigation.
Alex (SRE): Steps I can run now: a) apply tenant override `queue_depth_limit=4000` b) enable fast-shed `tail_shed_threshold=0.9` c) route new requests to warm pool in us-east-1. Priya, can you prepare a targeted runtime flag change?
Priya (Eng Runtime): Will do. Applying flags to finly-prod batcher set now (pushing config via deployer):
```
PATCH /config/tenants/finly-prod
{"queue_depth_limit":4000, "max_batch_wait_ms":20, "prefer_small_batches":true}
```
oncall-bot: Config patch queued: change-id cfg-7823 by Priya.
Alex (SRE): I'm throttling incoming traffic for finly-prod at the gateway (soft-drop) to keep queue under control. Applied rule id gw-rule-99.
Maria (Support): Customer updated: traffic looks better but still seeing occasional 504s. They want root cause and next steps.
Priya (Eng Runtime): After flags: queue_depth trending down to ~1800 over 3m, avg_batch_size dropped to 9, p95 improved to 420ms. Observed fewer kv cache misses.
Alex (SRE): Good. Next: we should run a targeted warmup for the model KV-cache for finly-prod (preload common prompts) and schedule a follow-up to tune quant path. Also create a short-lived dedicated capacity offer to the customer if they need SLA.
Sam (Customer Success): I'll propose the dedicated capacity option and share workaround: reduce max_seq or use chunking for large payloads.
Priya (Eng Runtime): Action items: - Priya: add tenant-config rollback window and monitor alerts for 30m. - Alex: keep gateway soft-drop active for 20m then re-evaluate. - Maria/Sam: update customer that we applied mitigations and will follow up with postmortem.
Maria (Support): Customer on call says latency stabilized; thanks. Logging this thread for postmortem.
Alex (SRE): Will file incident ticket with perf graphs + KV cache metrics. Linking traces: https://traces.internal/trace/abc123.
Priya (Eng Runtime): Quick note for postmortem: consider adding per-tenant longseq limits or automatic rerouting to dedicated for heavy longseq patterns.
oncall-bot: Incident marked \"mitigated\" by Alex at 17:46 UTC.
Maria (Support): Closing customer loop now. :thumbsup:
